feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: 80 Israelis and Americans, including NY Democrat Brad Lander, detained in West Bank
entry.summary: U.S. Democratic congressional nominee Brad Lander was detained along with about 80 American and Israeli rabbis and activists by Israeli security forces as they helped Palestinian olive harvesters.

entry.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
entry.summary: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: Expecting a baby? 5 tips to help you prepare for pregnancy costs
entry.summary: The cost of having a baby is difficult to predict. The amount families pay varies widely. Here are five tips to help you prepare for the often unexpected costs of pregnancy and giving birth.

entry.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
entry.summary: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us

entry.title: LeBron James talks smack with Knicks fans in victorious 76ers debut
entry.summary: The Sixers got a first look at the potent lineup they put together this summer in hopes of winning their first title since 1983.

entry.title: FAA clears the way for airlines to put Boeing's long-delayed 737 Max 10 into service
entry.summary: Nearly a decade after Boeing unveiled its largest 737 Max jet, the company has cleared a major hurdle in its effort to bring the plane to airlines.

entry.title: Zelenskyy says early warning system for Russian missile attacks resumes
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the change happened after talks with his American counterparts, including a phone call with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

entry.title: France announces nightly curfews 'for as long as necessary' in Paris and other cities
entry.summary: Fresh curfews were being imposed across the city centers of Paris and Lyon on Tuesday after the first quiet night since France's most destructive rioting in years.

entry.title: United Nations report highlights significant increase in U.S. climate pollution
entry.summary: The U.S. is the only major economy where planet-warming pollution dramatically increased last year. The United Nations warns the planet is on track for catastrophic warming.

entry.title: Some on DOJ's 20,000 "likely" noncitizen list in Calif. appear to be U.S.-born
entry.summary: Election officials in Los Angeles County say their preliminary analysis of the federal government's list of 20,000 "likely" noncitizens registered to vote in California shows the list is "unreliable."
